remarks: First time on the market since 1981, this North Redondo Beach property presents a rare opportunity to create something distinctly your own. Offering two bedrooms and two bathrooms within approximately 1,476 square feet, the home sits on a generous approximately 7,484-square-foot lot. The deep parcel, approximately 50 feet by 150 feet, provides substantial outdoor space and an appealing canvas for a new vision. The residence has remained largely in its original condition, creating an opportunity for thoughtful renovation and personalization.
